searchText: Tracking the Medalla inactivity leak, looks like we're still on target for just over another week of lack of finality before validators start being kicked. Note that the inactive validator in the graph started with ~30ETH, so it could be another day beyond this before we have removed enough for finality to resume. Seems like we had one finalization yesterday Beaconcha.in is reporting now more data again my node is still at epoch 15614 finalized and 15705 justified, was there a fork? I dont think we finalized anywhere unless I am missing something both zinken and medalla are unfinalized Indeed, I probably seen it wrong yesterday... Hmm Prysm had some improvements to allow beaconcha.in to update their webpage again
